title: The end of appeasement? EU threatens Trump with counter-tariffs over Greenland
summary: So much for appeasement: The same Europeans who held their nose and swallowed their pride when the EU agreed Donald Trump’s tariffs last summer can no longer ignore the obvious, that there are limits with a president of the United States who tends to treat them as vassals, not allies… even as adversaries for pushing back on its white nationalist brand of na…
